overview.title: Dividends
overview.subtitle: Upcoming ex-dates and dividends you've received (tracked via transactions).
overview.upcomingEmpty: No ex-dates found in portfolio or watchlist.
overview.receivedEmptyPrefix: No dividends recorded yet. On the
overview.receivedEmptySuffix: you can log received dividends as a transaction.

screener.title: Dividend top list
screener.scanTooltip: Re-scans the curated list freshly for all users
screener.scanConfirm: Start a fresh scan of the curated dividend list? Takes 20-60 seconds. The data will be updated for all users.
screener.scanDoneMessage: Scan done: {count} dividend payers from {universe} tickers in {seconds}s.
screener.intro: Scans a curated universe of well-known dividend names (US aristocrats, DAX, EU blue chips, REITs, utilities) plus optionally your portfolio + watchlist. The curated-list data is <bold>shared across all users</bold> and persists until someone presses "Re-scan". Portfolio and watchlist additions are loaded on the fly per user.
screener.snapshotInProgress: ⏳ A scan is in progress — results will appear shortly when done.
screener.customPlaceholder: Additional tickers, comma-separated (e.g. BMW.DE, O, JNJ)
screener.empty: No hits for the current filters.
screener.scoreNote: Score: Yield (max 25, capped above 8% to dampen dividend traps) + 5Y CAGR (max 30) + payout safety (max 20, prefers ≤ 60%) + streak (max 25). Sum 0-100. Tooltip on the score shows the individual components.

calendar.title: Dividend calendar
calendar.intro: Shows upcoming ex-dividend dates for your portfolio and watchlist tickers, current dividend rate (per share, annualized), dividend yield and payout ratio. Source: Yahoo Finance — so occasional gaps for special tickers or young companies.
calendar.annualRateDescription: Sum of annualized rates <bold>per share</bold> — multiply by your share count for your annual income. Converted to {base} using current spot FX.
calendar.empty: No dividend data in the selected filter.
